description: This file defines the SendgridService class responsible for synchronizing user contact data with Sendgrid, including creating, updating, and deleting contacts. It manages custom contact fields and provides methods for both console and web user operations.

classes.name: SendgridService
classes.description: A class extending SyncServiceCore that implements ISyncService to handle contact synchronization with Sendgrid, including upsert and delete operations for users.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a user contact in Sendgrid, handling custom fields and contact data formatting.

methods.name: console.user.upsert
methods.description: Wrapper method to upsert a console user.

methods.name: web.user.upsert
methods.description: Wrapper method to upsert a web user.

methods.name: web.user.delete
methods.description: Deletes a web user contact from Sendgrid based on email.
